exact_blockers.requirement: Provide exact deployable local YAMNet ONNX model/checkpoint, AudioSet label map artifact, and immutable hashes/byte counts/provenance.
Clear model/label/data rights, notices, redistribution, product-use, and publication terms before any claim.
Provide an isolated pinned runtime with deterministic execution recipe and recorded platform for the exact candidate.
Reproduce an approved exact-runtime reference on frozen inputs with hashed outputs and parity/tolerance verification.
Provide rights-cleared held-out rate/content evidence with source/output mapping, duration/pitch/transient/playback controls and task-matched scoring.
Pin and verify AudioSet label handling, class ordering, score calibration/cadence, window/hop, and timestamp mapping; keep scores advisory.
Keep any future SDK adapter optional, caller-supplied-asset, off by default, and outside installed v0/shared build/CI/public registration.
Record explicit default-selection, resource/deadline, release, and public-benchmark approval; missing evidence cannot qualify.

gates.requirement: Exact YAMNet ONNX source revision, ONNX model/checkpoint, AudioSet label map/class-name artifact, hashes, byte counts, and immutable manifests are pinned and present.
Acquisition, local evaluation, publication, redistribution, product-use, and derivative-output rights for model/labels/data are cleared with complete notices.
An approved exact-runtime reference reproduces the candidate on frozen inputs with hashed outputs and verified parity/tolerance policy.
A rights-cleared held-out rate/content cohort with task-matched scoring, source/output mapping, duration/pitch/transient/playback controls is present.
An isolated pinned runtime and deterministic command recipe reproduce outputs without network or hidden mutation.
AudioSet label handling, class ordering, score calibration/cadence, window/hop, and timestamp mapping are pinned and verified as advisory-only contract.
Any future SDK adapter is optional, caller-supplied-asset, preserves installed v0 behavior, and is not registered/enabled by default.
Explicit default-selection, resource/deadline evidence, and release/public-benchmark approval are recorded; default remains off.

non_claims: No YAMNet ONNX model, checkpoint, runtime, labels artifact, or derived weight is loaded, executed, staged, or redistributed.
No network request, download, dataset acquisition, or external runtime invocation occurs.
No real audio, real corpus, device timing, listening, public benchmark, or release/qualification claim is made.
AudioSet label handling and cadence metadata are advisory contract pins only; no event detection quality is claimed.
Candidate/source notes are pinned context only and are not promoted to measured or qualified evidence.
No provider, descriptor, registry, installed v0 path, shared build, CI, board, or handoff change is made.
Missing evidence never qualifies the candidate; decision remains DEFER and qualification remains not_qualified.

qualification.reason: No exact local YAMNet ONNX asset/runtime/rights/rate-cohort/reference parity evidence is present; labels/cadence remain advisory-only and unverified.

rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Measure source/output mapping, duration, pitch, transient audibility and playback buffering.
Include 1×, rate changes, unfamiliar speech, music, silence, rebuffer, drift and the final partial window.
Keep pause/filler decisions tied to source timestamps and measure speech preservation.
Record exact input/output cadence, window/hop, and AudioSet label handling; keep scores advisory.
Measure target-device/runtime CPU, memory, deadline, availability, and failure behavior for exact config.
Validate invalid/missing/nonfinite/adverse cases fail closed without qualification.
Reproduce exact model/runtime on frozen inputs with hashed outputs and parity/tolerance policy.
Obtain independent review and explicit release/default/public-benchmark approval before any qualifying claim.

reproduction.comparison: canonical JSON bytes and SHA-256 only; no tolerance
